messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: High tail latency and 5xx spike observed for /v1/generate on prod-us-west. Severity: P2. Pager escalated to SRE oncall.

maya (sre-oncall): got it, I'm on it. Seeing 95th p99 tokens latency up ~3-5x and errors ~4% for the last 18m.

rafael (eng-rot): adding context: we rolled a model variant 3 hours ago (v2-quant) — metrics show increased KV cache misses on long-conv workloads. Reverting to v1-std might reduce tail.

maya (sre-oncall): can you trigger a canary rollback? If it reduces latency we'll promote. Please post the exact command you run.

rafael (eng-rot): running rollback now. command: ```redwoodctl deploy rollback --env prod-us-west --service inference-api --to v1-std --reason \"latency spike\"```

incident-bot: Deploy started by rafael (eng-rot). Trace: deploy-0b3f.

maya (sre-oncall): rolling traffic off v2-quant to v1-std via routing policy. Watching metrics.

alex (sre-lead): quick note — while mitigation proceeds, we should prepare status page + customer notification drafts and start a preliminary SLA eligibility check. @sam (billing-ops) you'll want the impacted window.

sam (billing-ops): on it. I'll need the start/end timestamps for degraded service and an estimate of affected customers/requests. Maya — can you confirm when the spike began and when error rate returned to baseline?

maya (sre-oncall): spike start ~1732108200 (approx 23m before thread start), rollback completed and traffic shifted by 1732111400. Error rate fell to baseline by ~1732111600. I'll send a timeline once I finish verifying traces.

dina (cs): drafting a customer-facing note. Do we want a proactive email to customers who reported errors + a broader status page update? Also need wording for enterprise accounts re: SLA credits.

chris (product): yes, proactive to customers who saw >2% errors and a status page update for everyone. For enterprise, we should offer a human-reviewed credit assessment. Keep initial notice short and apologetic, with a follow-up that contains the credit eligibility procedure.

maya (sre-oncall): attaching short log excerpt: ```ERROR 2024-05-06T14:20:12Z inference::handler - KVCache miss ratio 0.72, kernel-queue delay 120ms```

rafael (eng-rot): root cause hypothesis: quantized kernel path for v2-quant regresses for >1024 token sessions, causing KV eviction storms. Fix will be in next runtime patch; for now we keep v1-std on prod.

sam (billing-ops): SLA process reminder: we calculate credits based on affected minutes within the billing period and customer SLA tier. I need per-customer impact slices (minutes of degraded service) and a list of accounts with requests routed to the degraded model. Dina — can you collect reported customers from support and tie to account IDs?

dina (cs): starting that list now. I'll pull from zendesk tags \"model-error\" and our telemetry. Will share in ~30m.

chris (product): internal status page copy (v0): \"We experienced elevated latency and errors for text generation in US-West between 14:10–14:40 UTC. Traffic has been routed to a stable model variant and service is operating normally. Root cause under investigation; we will share a follow-up with any affected customers about next steps and credit eligibility.\" Thoughts?

alex (sre-lead): good. Suggest removing specific minutes until we confirm timeline. Also add contact for enterprise customers. Example tweak: \"We experienced an elevated error rate and increased latency in US-West earlier today. The issue has been mitigated and normal service is restored. We are investigating the root cause and will reach out to affected customers with details on eligibility for service credits.\"

dina (cs): customer email draft (v0): \"Hi, we’re sorry — you may have experienced increased errors or latency while using Redwood Inference in US-West earlier today. We’ve mitigated the issue and are investigating the cause. If your application experienced errors impacting your SLAs, our team will follow up with an account-specific review and any applicable credits. Reply if you need priority assistance.\"

sam (billing-ops): that'll work as the short notify. For formal SLA credits we'll need: impacted time window (confirmed by SRE), per-account request counts during that window, SLA tier, and whether the customer had Dedicated/Private infra (credits different). I'll prepare a spreadsheet template.

chris (product): also prepare an internal template for legal and PR: short timeline + technical summary + list of affected accounts. Legal, can you review the proposed customer wording? @legal-team

legal-team: quick read — the draft is fine. Avoid definitive language like \"you will receive\" until billing completes the review. Use \"may be eligible\". Also retain records for audit; tag threads appropriately.

maya (sre-oncall): timeline (prelim): start 1732108200, mitigation start (rollback) 1732109900, rollback complete 1732111400, baseline by 1732111600. Will provide final validated timeline with traces and sample request IDs.

rafael (eng-rot): put a note in runbook: increase KV cache size for long sessions temporarily if we see similar pattern. I'll open PR with rollback playbook adjustments.

sam (billing-ops): next steps from billing: 1) SRE final timeline + per-account impacted requests 2) CS to map support tickets to accounts 3) Billing runs spreadsheet and proposes provisional credits 4) Review with legal/product -> finalize customer letters. Expect 48–72h for full reconciliation for enterprise accounts.

dina (cs): assigning owners: SRE -> maya for timeline and traces; Eng -> rafael for technical summary; CS -> dina for ticket mapping and customer list; Billing -> sam for credit calc; Product -> chris for customer messaging; Legal -> legal-team for wording.

maya (sre-oncall): tagging evidence: logs and traces uploaded to /incidents/1732109876/artifacts. I'll also attach a link to the Grafana dashboard in this thread.

chris (product): short-term status page update ready to go once timeline confirmed. Dina — once billing provides guidance on wording for affected customers, we'll send the targeted emails.

dina (cs): ack — I'll queue the outbound email template and start triaging support tickets for priority outreach.

sam (billing-ops): noted. I'll stand by for SRE's final timestamps. Will create the billing spreadsheet and share a link here when ready.

incident-bot: NOTE: Pager closed by maya (sre-oncall). Severity downgraded to monitoring.

maya (sre-oncall): closing loop — mitigation successful, we have postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 PT. Meanwhile, keep this thread for customer comms drafts and billing coordination.

rafael (eng-rot): opening PR for runtime patch and adding staging test for long sessions. ETA 2 days.

alex (sre-lead): thanks everyone. Action items summary (short): SRE validate timeline + share traces (maya), Engineering PR for fix (rafael), CS gather customer list & draft emails (dina), Billing calc & spreadsheet (sam), Legal review messaging (legal-team), Product approve public/status text (chris).

dina (cs): copying final customer email template here (ready to send after legal/billing review): \"Hi <Customer>, earlier today you may have experienced errors or increased latency from our inference service in US-West. We’ve mitigated the issue. Our team is reviewing your traffic for any potential SLA impact — if eligible, we will apply service credits as outlined in your agreement. We will follow up with a personalized summary within 72 hours. Apologies for the disruption and thank you for your patience. — Redwood Support\"

sam (billing-ops): received. I'll populate spreadsheet and tag potential credit amounts as provisional. Thanks all.

chris (product): closing note: for public status we will use alex's wording and push to status.redwood.ai after timeline confirmed. I'll coordinate posting.

maya (sre-oncall): final — keeping thread open for updates. If anyone posts new customer drafts or billing artifacts, prefix with \"[ARTIFACT]\" so we can easily grep the thread.

incident-bot: Incident summary: P2 latency/5xx spike, US-West, mitigated via rollback to v1-std, timeline & artifacts uploaded, follow-ups assigned.
